reading: The second series of The Celebrity Traitors ended on Friday.
More than 15 million people watched the series.
There were 21 players at the start, but only seven reached the last show.
Romesh Ranganathan and Sebastian Croft won the game together.
The winners will give the money to two charities, groups that help people in need.
Sebastian cried because he was very happy.
Romesh hoped his mum was proud of him.

vocabulary.definition: people who take part in a game
with another person or other people
money or something else you get when you win
had water come from the eyes because of a strong feeling
happy because you or someone else did something well
